snippet.title: Bicyclism EP - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
• Available now on Steam •
http://store.steampowered.com/app/507030

• Humble Store •
https://www.humblebundle.com/store/bicyclism-ep

• itch.io •
https://phosphoer.itch.io/bicyclism-ep

• Soundtrack available on Bandcamp •
https://yuxxie.bandcamp.com/album/bicyclism-ep-the-soundtrack

• Follow Us •
@bicyclismgame
https://twitter.com/bicyclismgame

• David Evans •
@phosphoer
https://twitter.com/phosphoer

• Andrew Nack (Yuxxie) •
@HelloYuxxie
https://twitter.com/HelloYuxxie
https://soundcloud.com/yuxxie

• Seth Pearson •
@Seth_Pearson
https://twitter.com/Seth_Pearson

Bicyclism EP is a physics based party game for up to 4 split-screen players. Play as your favorite bicycle and compete in traditional bicycle games like racing, jousting, soccer, space mushroom hunting, wrestling, etc.
